select
,(case tfg.PORTFOLIO_ID when #{planInfo.portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 ELSE 99 end) order1 ,(case tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 when #{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 ELSE 99 end) order2
,(case tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 when #{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 ELSE 99 end) order3
, 99 as order3
,(case tfg.TERM_TYPE when #{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 ELSE 99 end) order4
, 99 order4
,(CASE tfg.CUSTOMER_ID WHEN #{planInfo.brokerageNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 1 ELSE 99 END) order5
, 99 order5
,(CASE tfg.SEC_ACCT_ID WHEN #{planInfo.secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 1 ELSE 99 END) order6
, 99 order6
,(CASE tfg.REGIST_ORG WHEN #{planInfo.registOrg, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 1 ELSE 99 END) order7
, 99 order7
,(CASE tfg.TRADE_PLAT WHEN #{planInfo.tradePlatform, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 1 ELSE 99 END) order8
, 99 order8
from TRD_FEE_CONFIG tfg /* 交易费用配置 */ where tfg.EFF_DATE <= #{feeDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND tfg.TRADE_MARKET = #{planInfo.tradeMarket, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.FEE_TYPE = #{planInfo.feeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.TRADE_TYPE = #{planInfo.tradeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.PS = #{planInfo.ps, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.TERM_TYPE = #{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.CUSTOMER_ID = #{planInfo.brokerageNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = #{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = #{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY order1, order2, order3, order4, order5, order6, order7, order8, tfg.EFF_DATE

select
from TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL TFCL WHERE TFCL.CONFIG_SEQ_NO = #{seqno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by TFCL.GRADE_AMT, TFCL.GRADE_CONDITION
